title: DMP send input
description: What a sender gives (section 4.1). Structural rules only: byte limits, the one-line rule, blank bodies, the address grammar, gate rules and every rule that depends on the kind or the reply target are left to section 4.5.

body.description: The text, in Markdown; at most 64 KiB.

data.description: Any JSON value of at most 64 KiB as JCS: gate data (gate-data.schema.json), private data or a marker.

idempotencyKey.description: The sender's own key for replaying a send (section 4.9); not stored in the envelope.
